title: Value of a block under the block bijection
statement: For natural numbers $n,b$, a bit string $r$ indexed by the $nb$ positions, and an index $i$ among the first $n$ positions, the integer represented by the $i$th block under the standard bijection between length-$b$ bit strings and integers from $0$ to $2^b-1$ equals the value of the length-at-most-$b$ substring of the list of bits of $r$ beginning at position $ib$.
